Class Department

java.lang.Object
com.supermarketstore.department.Department
public class Department extends Object
Represents a department in the supermarket. Contains information about its location, budget, staffing, and refrigeration requirements.
Author:
Hanna Bokariuk

  • Constructor Details

    • Department

      public Department()
      Creates an empty department instance for Jackson deserialisation.

    • Department

      public Department(int departmentId, String name, int floor, int zone, double budget, int employeeCount, boolean isRefrigerated)
      Creates a department without attached image metadata.
      Parameters:
      departmentId - the department identifier
      name - the department name
      floor - the floor where the department is located
      zone - the department zone on the floor
      budget - the allocated department budget
      employeeCount - the number of employees assigned to the department
      isRefrigerated - whether the department requires refrigeration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when any core department value is invalid

    • Department

      public Department(int departmentId, String name, int floor, int zone, double budget, int employeeCount, boolean isRefrigerated, String fileName, String contentType, int fileSize, byte[] departmentImage)
      Creates a department with optional attached image metadata.
      Parameters:
      departmentId - the department identifier
      name - the department name
      floor - the floor where the department is located
      zone - the department zone on the floor
      budget - the allocated department budget
      employeeCount - the number of employees assigned to the department
      isRefrigerated - whether the department requires refrigeration
      fileName - the attached image file name when image data is present
      contentType - the attached image content type when image data is present
      fileSize - the attached image size in bytes when image data is present
      departmentImage - the optional attached image bytes
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when any core department value is invalid
